steps.name: verify-audited-stage9b-cache-and-install-runner
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = ffe4cf12152f1235b734d41695f7ce3abb82e18c; test -f build/climate_v6_full_seed1847_vpd.npz; test -f build/climate_v6_full_seed1847_vpd_metadata.npz; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_dataset_audit_seed1847_vpd.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['audit']['ready_for_training'] is True
assert d['config']['rows'] == 7200
assert d['config']['families'] == 15
assert d['audit']['split_counts'] == {'train': 4800, 'validation': 1200, 'test': 1200}
assert d['audit']['humidity_mode_counts'] == {'RH': 6240, 'VPD': 960}
print('STAGE9C_AUDITED_CACHE_GATE=PASS')
PY
git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage9c/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py > tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: full-weighted-training-experiment
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_weighted_training_seed1847_vpd.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['dataset']['rows'] == 7200
assert d['dataset']['vpd_rows'] == 960
assert d['artifact']['parameter_count'] == 2502
assert d['artifact']['portable_max_prediction_delta'] <= 2e-5
assert d['training']['winner_test'] is not None
assert len(d['training']['candidates']) >= 2
for name, stats in d['training']['winner_test_strong_ratio'].items():
    assert stats['strong_count'] > 0, name
print('STAGE9C_WEIGHTED_REPORT_GATE=PASS')
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage9c-experiment
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py reports/ml/climate_v6_weighted_training_seed1847_vpd.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.npz reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.json; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/run_weighted_climate_v6_training.py reports/ml/climate_v6_weighted_training_seed1847_vpd.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.npz reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.json; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Train weighted RH and VPD climate model'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
